newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber offer prices were unchanged in late trading on Friday, with sellers holding out against low bids, traders said.
"There were a number bids today, but players did not want to sell because they (bids) were too low," said one trader.
"I believe this trend will continue next week. There don't seem to be any fresh factors that could boost the poor market sentiment," said another trader.
Traders said June offer prices were quoted at 49.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang and at 49.50 fob Medan and Surabaya.
Offer prices were quoted at 49.00 cents fob Padang and at 48.75 cents fob Pontianak and Jambi.

Some traders said prices could fall further because raw material was abundant in Indonesia, while others see the possibility of offer prices falling to as low as 45.00 cents if the bearish trend continued.
